254:t_030:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「That's rare, $$竜馬$$. You actually praised us.」

254:t_030:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「Even he must feel lonely after being thrown into a sea of stars.」

254:t_030:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Your smart mouth hasn't changed, either. You're still a kid that way, even as an old man.」

254:t_030:4.en:
$$弁慶$$
「You bastard...! Just because you're a little younger than us!」

254:t_030:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「Leave him alone, $$弁慶$$. Apparently that's all he has to boast about.」

254:t_030:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You bastard...! Don't get carried away!」

254:t_030:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What are you doing, everyone?! We're in the middle of a battle!」

254:t_030:8.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Oops! Miss $$スズネ$$ told us off!」

254:t_030:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Just wait, $$隼人$$! Once this battle is over, I'll beat you up before I put $n through his paces!」

254:t_100:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wherever we are, I won't show mercy to anyone who attacks us!」

254:t_100:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's go! I'll get home fast and fight to protect Earth's peace and our company's safe!」

254:t_101:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We'll win this battle, no matter what, so we can return to Earth!!」

254:t_102:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's do it, $$マジンガー$$! Even at the edge of space where sunlight can't reach, you'll light up the darkness!」

254:t_102:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「We'll never give up! We'll show the $$インベーダー#robot$$s that!」

254:t_103:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
(...Something has been racing through my body for a while now...)

254:t_103:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
(Is this... a premonition of battle...?!)

254:t_104:0.en:
$$タケル$$
(This is the sea of the galaxy, my birthplace...)

254:t_104:1.en:
$$タケル$$
(I wonder why... I feel like I can hear $$マーグ$$'s... my brother's voice from somewhere...)

254:t_105:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「I've been used to fighting in places I don't know ever since I left $$ジーハ村$$!」

254:t_105:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「Get out of the way, $$インベーダー#robot$$s! There's a woman on Earth waiting for me to save her!!」

254:t_106:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I, $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$, and the $$ガンバスター$$ have fought our way through the sea of space...!」

254:t_106:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Come at me, $$インベーダー#robot$$s! I'll knock you down, every last one!」

254:t_107:0.en:
$$葵$$
「Here we are in a romantic sea of stars, and my dates are $$インベーダー#robot$$s...」

254:t_107:1.en:
$$葵$$
「I don't want to see your faces anymore! So I'll finish you off quickly!」

254:t_108:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「You're here, my dear $$インベーダー#robot$$s! Not that I'm happy to see you!」

254:t_108:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「If you attack us, I'll show no mercy! I'm not dying before I get back to Earth!!」

254:t_109:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...Damn it! I don't have time for these imitation $$宇宙怪獣$$...!」

254:t_109:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We're going back to Earth! If you get in our way, I'll show no mercy!」

254:t_110:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I understand... I know you're humanity's enemies! Because...!」

254:t_110:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ is the one who carries on $$ノノリリ$$'s will, a warrior who protects Earth's peace!」

254:t_111:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「I'm not dying in a place like this! We have a mountain of things to do on Earth!」

254:t_111:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do it! Wherever we are, we're heading straight for justice with burning passion!!」

254:t_112:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hey, $$メール$$? If we're fighting $$インベーダー#robot$$s, there's no need to hold back, right?」

254:t_112:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then, since I have permission, I'm going all out!!」

254:t_112:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「The $$ガンレオン$$ and I will crush anyone who gets in the way of our return to Earth!!」

254:t_112:4.en:
$$メール$$
「Oh... I feel like he's going to overdo it...」

254:t_113:0.en:
$n
(I'm sorry, $$宗介$$... I couldn't save you and $$千鳥$$...)

254:t_113:1.en:
$n
(But it isn't over yet...! I... We will get back to Earth!)

254:t_113:2.en:
$n
(And I'll do it...! I'll rescue $$千鳥$$, no matter what!)

254:t_114:1.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「It will take a little longer to determine our location.」

254:t_114:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「I understand. But we've already steeled ourselves.」

254:t_114:3.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We'll return to Earth by any means necessary! Until then, we'll survive whatever we face!」

254:t_115:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I never thought I'd see you again in a sea of stars like this.」

254:t_115:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Don't complain. We didn't come here by choice, either.」

254:t_115:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「That's right. Let's finish off these small fry and figure out how to get home.」

254:t_115:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I agree! I'm even more tired of seeing them than your faces!」

254:t_116:0.en:
$$凱$$
「Not long ago, we were fighting $$サイデリアル$$ on Earth. Now we're suddenly in the middle of a sea of stars.」

254:t_116:1.en:
$$渓$$
「Don't whine, $$凱$$! With the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, we can handle anything that happens!」

254:t_116:2.en:
$$號$$
「That's right, $$渓$$. Where there's hope, light is born.」

254:t_117:0.en:
$$グーラ$$
($$バアル$$, including $$インベーダー#robot$$s, are appearing in huge numbers... And that army is moving...)

254:t_117:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
(Something is about to happen in the universe... Is this a sign of the universe's collapse, which happens once every 12,000 years...?)

254:t_117:2.en:
$$グーラ$$
(No... That's not it. I feel something even greater... is about to happen...)
